rationale: Reframes the single prose sentence as an explicit ordered procedure so the tracked-.gitignore-and-commit step is sequenced before `git worktree add`. The ordering (P_order) is the parameter implicated by the failure cluster, and numbered steps make the precedence harder to skip than a flat instruction. The directory-precedence rules are preserved verbatim in step 1.
expected_effect: On `default-hidden`, the agent should add `.worktrees/` to tracked `.gitignore`, commit it at HEAD, then create the worktree, so HEAD:.gitignore contains `.worktrees/` and the verifier passes. Reliable tasks remain unaffected because their existing directories are already ignored and step 1 short-circuits creation.
regression_risk: Low. Numbered reordering does not change directory selection or test execution; the only added obligation is a committed ignore rule, which is a no-op when the rule already exists. Minor risk: an agent might over-eagerly commit an unrelated .gitignore change, but the instruction scopes the commit to the chosen directory path.
